test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

His mouth __left open as he realise__ the truth.

options.text: was felt opened as he realise

solution:
The correct answer is **fell open as he perceived**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct part to be used in place of the underlined part is fell open as he perceived.
 
• In the sentence given above, the sentence is in the past tense since his mouth was left open after realising the truth.
 
• So, **perceived** should be used (past tense of **perceive**).
 
• Hence, the complete sentence would be, *His mouth **fell open as he perceived**__ the truth.*

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 1).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Perceive**: to attain awareness or understanding of (समझना)

 
 
• **Ex: ***Scientists failed to **perceive** how dangerous the level of pollution had become.*
